scope: six-direction followup, not a replacement for transfer matrix; fixed while the new transfer matrix has no GT results
human_visual_motivation: Treat equivalent descriptions consistently and respect attribute implication; do not assume every clothing description is mutually exclusive.
hypotheses: Fixed 17-query exclusivity may be too restrictive for nested Tshirt/shirt descriptions; relax identically for ordinary and proposed as an engineering/fairness control, not our exclusive innovation.
Conservative text-derived equivalence/implication links regularize separate KD outputs; this may share sparse evidence across paraphrases without new teachers.
primary: Same protocol/visual JOINT unary followed by least-squares probability projection onto conservative query implication constraints; ordinary independent per-query >.5 decoding for all arms.
controls: JOINT plus fixed query-permuted implication graph (placebo; same graph edges)
RAW_TEACHER_FILL with the same independent decoder
fixed_math: Unweighted min ||p-u||²/2 under p[a]<=p[b], Hildreth dual coordinate updates, tolerance1e-8/max10000; probabilities not multiplied as independent evidence.
text_assumptions: Parsed attributes conservative; other qualifier words remain ordered and opaque.
Within-video unique sport qualifier can be supplied by query set, not annotations.
Tshirt implies shirt; no hard mutual colour/identity exclusion added.
No claim parsed constraints are annotation ground truth.
GT_barrier: All six directions/three seeds and both-direction CountMatched controls sealed before this followup evaluation. No target GT selects numerical parameters or checkpoint.
acceptance: Review all six directions against full ordinary family and neutral decoder; module gain must survive same-decoder controls and placebo; negative results preserved.
